newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Death sentence for Saudi who killed Filipina.
newsitem.headline: Death sentence for Saudi who killed Filipina.

text.p: Kuwait's appeals court has upheld a death sentence against a Saudi man convicted of killing a Filipina while raping her, a newspaper said on Wednesday.
"The court of appeals on Tuesday upheld a death sentence issued against a Saudi national who was convicted of raping and strangling to death a maid," the Arab Times said.
"He strangled her to death and still continued to rape her," it said.
The man had confessed to the charges but said that he had thought the woman was unconscious rather than dead as he continued to rape her, it said.
It did not disclose the name of the man or that of the victim but said she had worked for his friend.
The ruling becomes final upon ratification by the Court of Cassation and the Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah. Kuwait hangs people sentenced to death.
In January Kuwait handed over to the kingdom two Saudi nationals accused of smuggling illicit drugs. Saudi Arabia beheads convicted drug smugglers by the sword in public.
